summary: This note is a short biography of Logan Wade Lerman, an American actor born January 19, 1992. It covers his early commercial and television work, his breakout film roles, and his later dramatic and action films. It is best known for playing the title role in the Percy Jackson fantasy-adventure films.
one_line: Biography of American actor Logan Lerman, known for the Percy Jackson films and roles in 3:10 to Yuma, The Perks of Being a Wallflower and Noah.
key_facts: Logan Wade Lerman was born January 19, 1992.
Logan Lerman is an American actor known for playing the title role in the fantasy-adventure Percy Jackson films.
Lerman appeared in commercials in the mid-1990s.
Lerman starred in the series Jack & Bobby (2004-2005).
Lerman appeared in the movies The Butterfly Effect (2004) and Hoot (2006).
Lerman gained further recognition for his roles in the western 3:10 to Yuma, the thriller The Number 23, and the comedy Meet Bill.
In 2009 Lerman appeared in Gamer and My One and Only.
Lerman played d'Artagnan in the 2011 film The Three Musketeers.
Lerman starred in the coming-of-age drama The Perks of Being a Wallflower (2012).
Lerman starred in the coming-of-age dramas Indignation (2016) and Sidney Hall (2017).
Lerman had major roles in the 2014 films Noah and Fury.
